description.text: Eleven hives stand in a row outside, silent and warm. Inside, the cottage is all beeswax and lamplight: frames stacked to be scraped, a long knife, muslin folded, and two people working without needing to say anything about it.

The hives stand in a row along the slope outside, eleven of them, the end one visibly busier than the rest. Inside, everything is wax and cedar and quiet industry: frames on the table, muslin over a settling jar, a hooked knife hanging where a hand falls on it. There is honey in a dish by the door for whoever comes up the path, which is almost nobody.

options.text: Step back out to the hill
